description: This file defines an internal class `PngStreamWriteHelper` that extends `Stream` to facilitate writing PNG data with chunk headers, length, and CRC calculations, primarily used within the PDFsharp library for handling PNG streams.

classes.name: PngStreamWriteHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending `Stream` to manage writing PNG chunks, including headers, lengths, and CRCs.

methods.name: WriteChunkHeader
methods.description: Writes the PNG chunk header bytes and clears the internal written buffer.

methods.name: WriteChunkLength
methods.description: Writes the length of a PNG chunk in big-endian format.

methods.name: WriteCrc
methods.description: Calculates CRC for the written data and writes it in big-endian format.
